title: Starter Portal — hero & orientation strip illustration suite
creator: Maya Alvarez
description: Create a coherent illustration and screenshot system for the Starter Portal landing experience. Deliverables include: a primary hero composition (responsive variants: desktop/tablet/mobile), a horizontal orientation strip that explains the 3-step 'onramp' flow, and two templated product screenshot treatments for embedding in docs and marketing. Focus is on clarity for first-time engineers: emphasize API keys, a single code sample, and a visual cue for latency/cost controls. Visual language should be distinct from previous compact-hero explorations — explore a layered ribbon motif and a limited color accent to improve scanability.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with final hero desktop/tablet/mobile frames and export-ready assets
Orientation strip with numbered steps and accessible color contrast (AA)
Two screenshot templates with grid overlay and annotation callouts
Design review sign-off from PM and Product Design Lead
Handoff package: export tokens, SVGs, 2x/3x PNGs, and a short usage doc in Drive
